sources.label: 开发者“Probably Alex”（[developer] 徽标）2026-09-01 说明
sources.quote: Just to clarify our use of AI during the development of Crimson Moon: generative AI was not used to create the game’s art, audio, narrative, or gameplay content. The world of Gildenarch and the characters, environments, stories, music, and experiences within it were crafted by our talented team of developers and artists. As disclosed on Steam, an AI-assisted tool was used for a preliminary translation pass, with that work then reviewed and revised by human localization professionals. Beyond this localization assistance, generative AI was not used to create the content you see and experience in Crimson Moon.
